description: Billing — turn the verify-on-return checkout into a real one: a shared order-recording helper, a signature-verified Stripe webhook that records orders even if the browser never returns (idempotent with the success page), a Billing Portal 'Manage subscription' action, a new nullable stripe_customer_id column (NEW migration, human-run), an order-history + current-plan section on the billing page, and the two footgun fixes (PurchaseButton fake-success on 503, and distinguishing 'billing misconfigured' from 'no plan'). All writes to orders use the service-role admin client; all new code degrades gracefully when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY / STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET / SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are absent. Depends on nothing else, but is the largest feature — do it carefully.
steps: Create NEW migration supabase/migrations/20261115_billing_customer.sql (do NOT edit existing migrations). Header comment: '-- Run this in the Supabase SQL editor before testing — the app cannot run DDL.' Body: `alter table public.orders add column if not exists stripe_customer_id text;`

Create src/lib/orders.ts ('server-only'): export async `recordOrderFromSession(session)` where session is the fetched Stripe checkout session object ({ id, amount_total?, currency?, customer?, metadata?:{user_id?,plan?} }). Get admin = createAdminClient(); if null, return (no throw). Derive plan = session.metadata?.plan; if missing return. billingType = plan === 'single' ? 'one-time' : 'monthly'. period_start = billingType === 'monthly' ? startOfCurrentUtcMonth() : null. admin.from('orders').upsert({ user_id: session.metadata.user_id, plan, billing_type: billingType, amount_cents: session.amount_total ?? 0, currency: session.currency || 'eur', status: 'paid', stripe_session_id: session.id, period_start, stripe_customer_id: (typeof session.customer === 'string' ? session.customer : null) }, { onConflict: 'stripe_session_id' }). Also export async `updateOrderStatusByCustomer(customerId: string, status: 'cancelled'|'paid')`: admin null-guard; admin.from('orders').update({ status }).eq('stripe_customer_id', customerId). Add a local startOfCurrentUtcMonth() (same impl as the success page / entitlements).

Refactor src/app/dashboard/services/success/page.tsx: keep verifyAndRecordOrder doing the session fetch (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY guard), the paid check (payment_status==='paid' || status==='complete') and the metadata.user_id === user.id check, but replace the inline upsert with a call to recordOrderFromSession(session) imported from '@/lib/orders'. No happy-path behavior change; still idempotent via onConflict:'stripe_session_id'.

Create src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts (POST handler). Read const sig = request.headers.get('stripe-signature'); const payload = await request.text(); const whSecret = process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; if (!whSecret) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Stripe webhook secret not configured.' }, { status: 503 }); if (!sig) return 400. Verify the signature inline with Node crypto: parse the stripe-signature header into t= and v1= parts, compute HMAC-SHA256 of `${t}.${payload}` with whSecret, timing-safe-compare against the v1 value, and reject (400) if it mismatches or the timestamp is outside a ~5 min tolerance. Parse the event = JSON.parse(payload). Switch on event.type: for 'checkout.session.completed' take the session id from event.data.object.id, re-fetch the full session from `https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions/{id}` with Authorization: Bearer STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (guard missing key → still return 200 so Stripe doesn't retry forever, but log), then call recordOrderFromSession(fullSession); for 'customer.subscription.deleted' or 'customer.subscription.updated' with status in ('canceled','unpaid') call updateOrderStatusByCustomer(event.data.object.customer, 'cancelled'); for 'invoice.paid' best-effort refresh the customer's monthly order period (may be a no-op with a code comment if not feasible without more plumbing). Return NextResponse.json({ received: true }) (200) for handled/ignored types. If createAdminClient() is null at write time the helpers no-op; the route still returns 200. Use export const runtime = 'nodejs' so crypto + raw body work.

Create src/app/dashboard/services/billing-actions.ts ('use server'): export async `openBillingPortal()`: const supabase = await createClient(); getUser, redirect('/login') if none; const secret = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; if (!secret) throw new Error('Billing is not configured yet.'); const admin = createAdminClient(); if (!admin) throw new Error('Billing is not configured yet.'); find the user's most recent paid monthly order WITH a stripe_customer_id: admin.from('orders').select('stripe_customer_id').eq('user_id', user.id).eq('status','paid').in('plan',['starter','growth','enterprise']).not('stripe_customer_id','is',null).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(1); if none throw new Error('No active subscription to manage.'); POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/billing_portal/sessions with URLSearchParams { customer, return_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || origin}/dashboard/services` } and Authorization Bearer; redirect(session.url). Document (code comment) that this uses the latest subscription order's customer id per the Phase-1 minimal approach.

In src/app/dashboard/services/PurchaseButton.tsx fix the 503 branch: instead of setSelected(true)+'Plan selected…' success styling, set a clearly-unavailable state — e.g. setUnavailable(true), show error text 'Checkout unavailable — payments aren\'t configured yet.' via .checkout-error, and render the button disabled with label 'Checkout unavailable' (NOT green 'Selected ✓'/.selected-plan). Remove the pseudo-success path entirely.
In src/lib/entitlements.ts export `function isBillingConfigured(): boolean { return createAdminClient() !== null }` (server-only; do not change getEntitlement's signature or return shape).

Update src/app/dashboard/services/page.tsx: (a) if !isBillingConfigured() render a distinct .attention-banner 'Billing is not configured — ask an administrator to set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.' in place of the 'No active plan' banner, so a misconfigured server is not shown as 'no plan'. (b) Add an order-history section: read the user's own orders via the request-scoped createClient() (SELECT RLS lets a user read own rows) ordered by created_at desc; render a .data-panel + .app-table with columns Plan (plans[o.plan]?.name ?? o.plan), Amount (€{(o.amount_cents/100).toFixed(2)}), Date, Status; show an empty-state when there are none. (c) Show current plan + remaining-campaigns from the existing getEntitlement data. (d) Render a 'Manage subscription' <form action={openBillingPortal}><SubmitButton label='Manage subscription' .../></form> ONLY when entitlement.plan is one of 'starter'|'growth'|'enterprise' (active monthly plan; hide for 'single'/null).
acceptance_criteria: A single recordOrderFromSession helper is used by BOTH the success page and the webhook, upserting with onConflict:'stripe_session_id' so an order is never double-counted.

The webhook returns 503 when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is missing, 400 on a missing/invalid signature, verifies the v1 HMAC-SHA256 signature with a timestamp tolerance, and records checkout.session.completed orders; subscription cancellation events flip matching orders to 'cancelled'.
openBillingPortal is owner-scoped, resolves the customer only from the user's own paid monthly orders, and throws a clear message when Stripe/admin is unconfigured or no subscription exists.
The new migration 20261115_billing_customer.sql adds a nullable stripe_customer_id and is flagged for a human to run; existing migrations are untouched.
PurchaseButton on HTTP 503 shows a disabled/unavailable state, not a fake 'Selected ✓'.

The billing page shows 'billing not configured' (distinct from 'No active plan') when the service-role key is absent, and otherwise lists the user's order history + current plan and shows 'Manage subscription' only for active monthly plans.
npm run lint exits 0 and npm run build succeeds.
verification: Run `npm run build` — must complete with no errors.

Manually confirm: all orders WRITES go through createAdminClient(); every new code path null-guards admin/Stripe env and never crashes; the success page and webhook share recordOrderFromSession with the same onConflict key; the billing order table is read owner-scoped.
findings: New migration: supabase/migrations/20261115_billing_customer.sql (adds nullable orders.stripe_customer_id; human must run in Supabase SQL editor). New env var required: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (the Stripe webhook signing secret; webhook returns 503 until set). New endpoint: POST /api/webhooks/stripe (signature-verified Node-runtime handler sharing recordOrderFromSession with the success page). FEAT-005 should document these.
